speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from mucous membranes, and petechiae. To understand the cause, have you noticed any easy bruising or bleeding after minor cuts recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP). The clinical picture of epistaxis, gum bleeding, petechiae, and easy bruising in a 4-year-old male is highly suggestive of ITP. I will confirm this with a platelet count and peripheral smear. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Platelets. REQUEST IMAGES: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.
